description:
Upload a CSV of names and domains to find their work email addresses in bulk.
When to use: When the user has a list of people and company domains and wants their emails.
Parameters: fileContent — CSV text; fileName — e.g. list.csv; hasHeaderRow (optional); domainColumn — 0-based column of the domain; firstNameColumn or fullNameColumn (one is required); optional lastNameColumn, middleNameColumn.
WRITE: Changes ZeroBounce account data (uploads, deletes, filters, tests, batch validation, warmup settings). Confirm with the user before calling.
CREDITS: Each successful call spends ZeroBounce account credits. Confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked for validation, enrichment, or activity data.

domainColumn.description: Column index (0-based) containing domain names. Defaults to 0 (first column).

fileContent.description: CSV file content as a string

firstNameColumn.description: Column index (0-based) containing first names. Give this or fullNameColumn.

fullNameColumn.description: Column index (0-based) containing full name values. Give this or firstNameColumn.

hasHeaderRow.description: Whether the first row of the file is a header row. Sent as false when not given.

name: send_email_finder_file
title: Upload file for email finder
